page.p: Pick individual Filters or Group By entries from this model's search view. Selected items are hidden from the search panel while the rest remain available.

field.placeholder: You are not allowed to modify this record.

page.name: reports_actions
page.p: Same options as the rule-level Hide Reports & Actions tab, scoped to this model. Lists are filtered to actions/reports linked to the selected model. Leave empty to use only the rule-level list.

Unchecked Create/Edit/Delete are enforced on the server. Domains restrict which records can be read/written/created/deleted. Use user.id or EU (Environment User) in domains for the current user, e.g. [('user_id','=',EU)]. Available context variables: user, uid, EU, time, company_id, company_ids. Enable Warn Instead of Block to show a notification instead of hard-blocking.

page.name: global_elements
page.div: Tip: Select a Reference Model to search for an element using the dropdown. The element will still be hidden globally across ALL models.

page.name: conditions
page.p: Build conditions using the domain selector. These domains are automatically converted to client-side JS expressions.

page.name: elements
page.p: Match buttons / notebook pages / fields by their technical name or visible label. Leave the condition empty to always hide.
